failure_cases: 創角輸入帳號與登入帳號不符
未登入直接以 C02 嘗試創角
scenarios.notes: 管理員經獨立管理 API 預建帳號；Client 僅能登入既有帳號。C02 無 Account.Create 權限；原生空角色轉場待 A-021。 Security: do not treat C02 before login as authenticated Account/Character owner. A-027 must establish proof. This remains analysis-required. A-002 designed: failed C03 never evicts current World; successful account auth alone issues generation-bound one-use transfer grant; login-socket close must not immediately revoke pending grant.
scenarios.known_from_roy1: C02 may be sent before C03; client C02 has no authority to create Account or claim admin-provisioned account
scenarios.a027_evidence: UI sends C02 with locally checked field1 length and field2/confirmation equality; cannot prove owner or native preprovisioned auth. Fail closed before independent identity proof.
scenarios.temporary_account_match_policy: If a valid authenticated account session exists, a submitted account name different from that logged-in account is denied (no C04-enable S02(0), draft, Character, or grant). Without authentication always deny. Exact C02 field semantics and native UI route remain unknown; policy is designed.

scenarios.title: 建角/交接/首次進圖的中斷恢復
scenarios.notes: 所有提交邊界前後斷線、重試和重啟，按已保存事實恢復，不複製角色、資產或教學完成狀態。 A-002 designed: old World disconnect/packet cannot remove new World generation; World C10 atomic consume; expired/reused/wrong-owner grant and crash residue are rejected. A-028 designed: Character durable commit cannot be undone by delayed C15; C04 retransmit same intent idempotent; after commit S02 success local UI, no automatic S03 assumption. A-016: bind Account generation, Character intent, transfer one-shot, map loading serial epoch, wallet/reward ledger; durable commit vs response sent distinguished; crash restores only committed snapshot.
